messages:
Aisha: morning—taking over from Tom. primary/secondary still: Tom primary, Aisha secondary until 07:30 UTC.
Tom: quick status: ongoing p99 latency on batcher-embed-usw2, started 06:12, spike coincides with KV evictions. Pager triggered twice. Customer impact: intermittent slow responses for embeddings-heavy clients, no data loss.
incident-bot: [ALERT] embedding-batcher latency > 2s (p99) — alert id: ALRT-5234 — escalated to on-call
Aisha: current mitigations in flight: 1) scaled batcher pool up by +2 nodes (done) 2) enabled soft-throttle at ingress to shed low-priority traffic (done) 3) warming secondary cache nodes (in progress)
Tom: logs show high eviction rate from prim-kv-cluster (OOM churn). I ran `kubectl get pods -n infra | grep kv` — prim-kv-0 repeatedly restarts.
Luis: noted. I pushed a config to increase `cache.eviction_window_ms` from 300 to 800 on prim-kv via ssm: `/infra/kv/prod/eviction-windows` — applied 06:44. Watching.
Aisha: runbook refs: RTE -> docs/runbooks/kv-eviction.md (section 3: graceful node drainage) and docs/runbooks/batcher-fallback.md for routing to secondary.
Priya: customer comms: engineering outreach queued for impacted customers; status page set to degraded for embeddings API @ 06:50.
Aisha: action checklist for next shift (Tom -> Aisha handoff now):
- verify prim-kv restarts have dropped (check `kubectl describe pod prim-kv-0`)
- confirm secondary cache warmed to >80% hit-rate (metric: `kv.hit_rate_5m`)
- if evictions persist, cutover read traffic to secondary by toggling `router.kv_read_preference = secondary` (feature flag in prod-kv-router)
- if latency still >2s p99 after cutover, enable full-rate shedding for embeddings non-premium routes: `rate-limit: embeddings:priority: non-premium: 10r/s`
Tom: handoff note: temp workaround I used: `curl -X POST https://ops-api/featureflag -d '{"key":"kv_force_secondary","value":true}'` — this forced reads to secondary for ~5m and reduced p99 to 1.2s. Not ideal - needs coordinated rollback.
Aisha: ongoing mitigations status: scale up complete, soft-throttle running, cache-warm started. Next ETA for cache-warm metrics: 07:10 UTC.
incident-bot: [NOTES] Pager silence set by Tom for 15m at 06:40.
Luis: I'll keep monitoring prim-kv logs and be ready to recycle node if memory doesn't stabilize. Will post logs here if I trigger restart.
Priya: keeping customers updated; next update planned at 07:00 UTC with ETA and mitigation summary.
Aisha: OK I'm now primary until 07:30 UTC. Tom, drop me any remaining runbook pointers before you sign off.
Tom: all done. watch `metrics.kv.evictions`, `metrics.batcher.queue_depth`, and `traces.batcher` for regressions. Signing off.
Aisha: thanks. If anyone needs to escalate, page `#oncall-escalation` and tag me directly. :thumbsup:
